description: Given a ticker, find every token using that symbol and say which one is most likely real. 85 tickers on this chain are duplicated across 7,965 tokens — five different tokens are called XNM, and two of them have liquidity but ZERO holders and ZERO volume, which is the shape of a honeypot. Ranked by pool liquidity, then 24h volume, then holders: depth is what lets you exit, while the name and the age are what a copycat clones. Free. Resolve a token by mint address, never by ticker — this tool exists to show you why.
name: impostor_check
